## Critique
- claim-1: Correctly grounded by [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-218].
- claim-2: Correctly grounded by [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 702-735], but this Hopf identity alone does not state the rectangular straightening identity (1).
- claim-3: Not established by the supplied strategy. Identity (1) is precisely the substantive missing step, yet no formula for \(F_{\rho,\sigma}\) or derivation from the accepted full-coordinate row identity is given. In particular, the accepted tall-to-wide identity concerns \(\operatorname{Lin}_\varphi\)-rows; a map carrying that row identity to
  \[
  s_{L_\rho}-(-1)^{|\rho|}s_{R_\rho}
  \in\sum_{\sigma\subsetneq\rho}\Lambda_{|\rho|-|\sigma|}s_{L_\sigma}
  \]
  is neither defined nor proved. The graded-kernel presentation only establishes independence of the lower-adjoined classes; it cannot supply the claimed coordinates of \(R_\rho\). Also specify that \(i^0\) is omitted when \(b=j\).
- claim-4: The cited accepted internal artifact corroborates the six identities only for \((i,j,a,b)=(2,3,2,2)\). Finite verification does not establish claim-3 for every \(\rho\) and every admissible parameter tuple.

## Repair certificates
- [proof-attempt] Define the rectangle-attachment operation used on the full-coordinate Hopf identity and prove, term by term, the displayed containment above, including the two endpoint coefficients \(1\) and \(-(-1)^{|\rho|}\), integrality, and why every remaining term has attachment \(\sigma\subsetneq\rho\). Then project to \(A\) and \(Q\).
- [computation] For the six cited small-case identities, provide ordered complete relation matrices \(M_d\) and explicit integral vectors \(z_\rho\) satisfying \(z_\rho M_d=e_{L_\rho}-(-1)^{|\rho|}e_{R_\rho}\), or equivalent unimodular Smith witnesses.
- [source-refresh] If identity (1) is intended to be source-backed, supply a bounded passage stating that exact rectangular identity. Existing [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 702-735] supports only the Hopf ingredient.

## Required revisions
- Replace the assertion “the full-coordinate Hopf descent gives (1)” with a checkable derivation.
- Define all \(F_{\rho,\sigma}\) or give an explicit finite formula producing them.
- Explicitly handle \(\rho=\varnothing\), \(a=0\), and \(b=j\).
- Conclude only after the missing derivation that the scoped certificate is established; the present output does not yet do so.
